subject: scoping billing down

messages.subject: scoping billing down
messages.body:
ok so hear me out

what if we build billing read-only first. just display what's in their current system, let them see it in Thicket, no editing, no invoice generation. two week build, maybe three.

then invoicing is post-seed, when we have the runway for it and aren't betting the company on a six-week module.

P

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body: wait does read-only actually close westbrook

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body: like can they see their outstanding invoices and who owes what

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body: because if yes then ok this might work

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body:
yes. import from their existing system, display it, search it, filter by outstanding/paid/overdue. everything they're looking at now in QuickBooks or whatever, just inside Thicket so they're not tabbing between three apps.

they still generate invoices in the old system for now. we sync the data back in.

P

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body: talked to westbrook this morning, they're fine with read-only if it means they get it this month instead of august. the tab-switching thing is actually what they complained about most

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body:
starting it friday. two weeks if nothing breaks, three if the QuickBooks import is worse than I think.

P

messages.subject: Re: scoping billing down
messages.body:
good

and hey this is the right call. you were right about the runway thing I just didn't want to hear it in may
